response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile senior full-stack engineer with strong software craftsmanship, open-source contributions, and some high-scale systems exposure (Sociomantic's microservices handling millions of requests/sec). However, the role requires Principal-level (IC6) leadership building experimentation, telemetry, and measurement platforms — an area where his resume shows no direct experience. There is no evidence of A/B testing frameworks, feature flighting, statistical analysis, growth measurement, or leading multi-team, multi-workstream initiatives, and his career trajectory reflects hands-on senior IC work rather than principal-level cross-org architecture ownership.
strengths: 20 years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded systems with strong TDD/CI/CD craftsmanship
High-scale distributed systems experience (low-latency services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Recent AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling work (MCP code generators, agentic workflows) aligns with the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth measurement platform experience anywhere in the resume
No demonstrated principal-level scope: no evidence of leading multi-team initiatives, org-wide architecture, or mentoring at scale
Limited data/statistics depth — no telemetry pipelines, metrics infrastructure, or experimental analysis background

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale exposure
